description: Canonical enum values shared by the web, iOS, Android, and desktop clients. Regenerate the per-language constants with `bun run --filter @exp/domain-contract generate`. The committed generated files (apps/ios/.../DomainContract.generated.swift, apps/android/.../DomainContract.generated.kt, apps/desktop/crates/domain/src/contract.generated.rs) are checked in so native builds don't need a Node runtime.

codingSessionBlocked.$comment: NEW-1: rate_limit = the usage wall (device-written; FEED-129: the server watchdog clears one whose resetsAt passed); device_offline, unclaimed, stuck = the server watchdog (sessionWatchdog).

sessionWatchdog.$comment: NEW-1: the server watchdog (every minute). A queued session nobody claimed for unclaimedMinutes = blocked:unclaimed + Needs you; a live session with pending input older than nudgeMinutes = the device is nudged again; a busy session with no device report for stuckMinutes = blocked:stuck; a host device silent past device.onlineWindowSeconds = its live sessions idle + blocked:device_offline until its next heartbeat; a rate_limit wall whose resetsAt passed = cleared (FEED-129).

deviceAgentDefaults.$comment: Owner 2026-10-15: every model is EXPLICIT, no blank/CLI default anywhere. A device that never set a key reads these; a launch always passes a model. threadModel = the dispatcher root of a thread or team agent (codexThreadModel for codex roots).

composerUi.conflictNote: Merge refused: the branch has conflicts.

conversationKind.$comment: NEW-3: conversations.kind. Every session owns ONE conversation of kind `session` (messages.conversation_id; messages.session_id stays as the step-1 read shim). `dm` and `channel` = people talking (step 2, NEW-8); an agent DM is the agent's conversation SESSION for that member.

planCard.$comment: EXP-1280 custom plan mode: the caps of exponential_plan_propose and exponential_sessions_ask (the card's behaviour = fixtures/plan-card.json). Pictures are named by `label` in the call and uploaded afterwards; until the upload lands the markdown embeds `![alt](upload:<label>)` and an option names its picture by label.

codingModel.$comment: THE Claude model vocabulary for EVERY model pick (session model, subagents, thread, computer use), shown in this order by ONE model picker x4.

agentTrigger.$comment: NEW-2: triggers live on the `agents` definition and the SERVER fires them every watchdog tick. schedule = a 5-field cron with minutes (`m h dom mon dow`) read in an IANA `tz` (default UTC); a tick missed while the server was down is caught up on the next one within catchUpHours, once; a schedule never stacks while its last firing is unread. event = the name of an `events` row.

timeZones.$comment: NEW-2: the ONE time-zone list every schedule picker offers (`schedule-picker.json`): UTC, then ICU's canonical IANA zones (Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone'), sorted). The server validates a trigger's tz with the same ICU (`timeZoneSchema`), so every row here saves; a stored zone off the list is offered as its own row.

events.$comment: NEW-2: the team's event stream (`events` shape). builtinNames = what the server emits itself; any other name is a custom event (MCP events_emit). Rows older than retentionDays are pruned.

steerCommands.$comment: NEW-2 (owner 2026-10-21): the composer's `/` menu = the team's PROMPTS (the `prompts` shape, a pick inserts the prompt as the run's first message) plus ONLY these builtins; commands the agent CLI injects from outside Exponential (Claude Code skills, plugins) are hidden on every platform. /model <alias> is sent as text (the CLI switches, config_state reports it), /effort <level> = sessions.configure.
